# The pair the Rada is in: D leads (the faction in power) and X is second. A tie between the two others keeps the old runner-up
# (kru_rada_second_<faction>), and with no old runner-up the order knyazi, boyary, starshyna decides.
kru_pair_boyary_knyazi = {
	faction_in_power = kru_knyazi
	OR = {
		kru_ahead_boyary_starshyna = yes
		AND = {
			NOT = { kru_ahead_starshyna_boyary = yes }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_boyary
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_starshyna }
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

kru_pair_starshyna_knyazi = {
	faction_in_power = kru_knyazi
	OR = {
		kru_ahead_starshyna_boyary = yes
		AND = {
			NOT = { kru_ahead_boyary_starshyna = yes }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_starshyna
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_boyary }
					always = no
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

kru_pair_knyazi_boyary = {
	faction_in_power = kru_boyary
	OR = {
		kru_ahead_knyazi_starshyna = yes
		AND = {
			NOT = { kru_ahead_starshyna_knyazi = yes }
			OR = {

				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = kru_rada_second_starshyna }
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# How firm the leader's grip is: the faction in power with at least this much influence. The bar moves right by a quarter, a half or
# three quarters at 50, 55 and 60; below 50 the Rada is contested and the bar stays in the centre.
kru_leader_influence_60 = {
	OR = {
		AND = { faction_in_power = kru_knyazi faction_influence = { faction = kru_knyazi influence = 60 } }
		AND = { faction_in_power = kru_boyary faction_influence = { faction = kru_boyary influence = 60 } }
		AND = { faction_in_power = kru_starshyna faction_influence = { faction = kru_starshyna influence = 60 } }
	}
}

kru_leader_influence_55 = {
	OR = {
		AND = { faction_in_power = kru_knyazi faction_influence = { faction = kru_knyazi influence = 55 } }
		AND = { faction_in_power = kru_boyary faction_influence = { faction = kru_boyary influence = 55 } }
		AND = { faction_in_power = kru_starshyna faction_influence = { faction = kru_starshyna influence = 55 } }
	}
}

kru_leader_influence_50 = {
	OR = {
		AND = { faction_in_power = kru_knyazi faction_influence = { faction = kru_knyazi influence = 50 } }
		AND = { faction_in_power = kru_boyary faction_influence = { faction = kru_boyary influence = 50 } }
		AND = { faction_in_power = kru_starshyna faction_influence = { faction = kru_starshyna influence = 50 } }
	}
}
